definitions.full: H3344. yaqad [ יָקַד ] verb be kindled, burn (Aramaic יְקַד , , burn , intransitive; Arabic , id. ) — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יֵקַד Isa 10:16 ; 3 feminine singular וַתִּיקַד Deut 32:22 ; Participle active feminine יֹקֶ֫דֶת Isa 65:5 ; passive יָקוּד 30:14 ; — be kindled , figurative of judgment, אֵשׁ כִּיקוֺד יְקֹד יֵקַד 10:16 ; so burn , Deut 32:22 a fire hath been kindled ( קָֽדְחָה ) in my wrath , עַדשְֿׁאוֺל וַּתִּיקַד and it burneth unto Sh®°ôl ; figurative of people displeasing to כָּלהַֿיּוֺם יֹקֶדֶת אֵשׁ בְּאַמִּי עָשָׁן אֵלֶּה ׳י, Isa 65:5 ; participle יָקוּד kindled , as substantive מִיָּקוּד אֵשׁ לַחְתּוֺת 30:14 to take fire from that which is knidled , i.e. from the hearth (Lg BN 60 ).
